subject.title: WhatsApp group messages never reach inbound handling (LID groups?) — DMs work; repro across relink + 2026.6.11→2026.7.1

question: Should the official WhatsApp plugin change its default linked-device browser identity and require a guided re-pair for affected existing sessions, or preserve the current default and expose an opt-in identity mode?
rationale: The live workaround is convincing, but changing identity is an upgrade-sensitive product decision because existing credentials can enter a 428 loop and the repository discourages adding configuration when a reliable default and doctor recovery can solve the problem.

options.title: Change default with guided re-pair
options.body: Adopt the proven Desktop identity for new sessions and add detection plus doctor/setup guidance for existing credentials that must be re-paired.

options.title: Add an opt-in identity setting
options.body: Preserve current behavior by default and expose a plugin setting for users willing to re-pair, at the cost of another compatibility-sensitive config surface.

options.title: Hold for upstream proof
options.body: Keep the issue open without changing defaults until direct Baileys testing isolates whether identity, history sync, or both are required.

recommendation.title: Change default with guided re-pair
recommendation.body: Adopt the proven Desktop identity for new sessions and add detection plus doctor/setup guidance for existing credentials that must be re-paired.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision changes the official WhatsApp plugin's default pairing identity and user-visible upgrade behavior.
